_comment: Crafting recipes. Keyed by recipe id (usually = output item id). station = the placeable entity id whose panel offers this recipe. process_ticks is the ONLY speed knob (10Hz: tiny ~= instant, 200 = 20s). catalyst (optional) is a required+consumed extra input. unlock: '' (or 'default') = always available at the station; 'recipe:<id>'/'shop:<npc>' are future seams honored once player persistence lands (gating today is implicit: you must own/build the station). Stage-1 set uses existing-art I/O only.
